# Vendored dependencies

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified SheetJS Community Edition tarball distributed by SheetJS at
`https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz`.

It is vendored because the `xlsx` package published on the npm registry is no longer the current
Community Edition release. Update the version, checksum, package lock, and this note together.
